source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary:
Your **SCOUT SENTINEL** and **ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY SMOKE** units gain **Signal Flares**: in your [Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase), such a unit may pick one enemy unit it can see within 12", which is **designated** for the rest of the phase and so has +3" **detection range**.

Carrying the **RECON** tag, this detachment cannot be combined with another **RECON** detachment.

grants.unresolved: Withheld as a class: the last two independent reviews found 3 of 73 ability grants of Detachment rules (every record of the class not withheld otherwise, each time) wrong or partly wrong, not under the 2% this reading may ship with.

Signal Flares.durationBasis: Core Rules 01.02.02: with no duration printed, the status lasts for the rest of the phase it was applied in.
